founder_scenarios.description: Broad empirical founder priors derived from focused_yuya_thuya_tiye_trio_l1_l2_founders by shrinking each locus toward a uniform allele distribution. Explicit person-specific founder genotype priors are removed.

Restricted endogamous founder priors derived from focused_yuya_thuya_tiye_trio_l1_l2_founders by concentrating each locus on the observed/listed allele pool and capping 'other' mass. Explicit person-specific founder genotype priors are removed.
